auth_type.correction: jwt or multi (CDP API key + JWT Bearer for Advanced Trade / CDP; Sign-in with Coinbase OAuth2 and legacy Coinbase App keys also exist — not a simple X-Api-Key apiKey header alone)

rate_limits.correction: Published per product (e.g. Advanced Trade public 10 req/s, private 30 req/s; Coinbase App / exchange endpoints document specific limits — not "not published")

example.correction: Public spot price does not require X-Api-Key; correct unauthenticated example: curl https://api.coinbase.com/v2/prices/BTC-USD/spot (no API key header). Response shape is data.amount/base/currency.

notes: Entry mixes Coinbase App v2 public prices with CDP trading auth. Auth is JWT/OAuth2 not X-Api-Key; rate limits are published; example wrongly requires API key for public endpoint.
